name: IG9400 Ultrasonic Open-Channel Flowmeter
shortDescription: Non-contact ultrasonic level sensing calculates flow through configured open-channel weirs and flumes. A separate probe and display arrangement provides instantaneous and accumulated flow information for applications such as wastewater discharge points, irrigation and municipal water engineering.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Split type, suitable for different on-site installation requirements
◆ Automatic adjustment of transmission power based on flow rate, advanced digital model calculation, anti-interference design
◆ Easy to use, reliable results, interface operation instructions can reduce operational errors
◆ The probe material is available in POM, PVDF, and PTFE, suitable for various working conditions
◆ Internally integrated temperature sensor, capable of real-time temperature compensation for sound velocity

Technical parameters:
Liquid level height: ≤ 5m
Instantaneous flow rate: determined by the type and specifications of the measuring weir tank used
Accumulated traffic: 0-99999999999m ³
Resolution: 0.001m ³/h
Accuracy: 2%
Blind spot: 0.3m
Display mode: LCD display
Launch angle: 6 °~10 °
Protection level: Protection level: Transmitter: IP65； Transmitter: IP68
Power Supply: DC18-36V； AC90-260V
Signal: 4-20mA, RS485 (optional)
Alarm: Multi way relay
